scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Collection consists of documents and proposals pertaining to parent involvement in day care, originally gathered for the White House Conference on Children and Youth. Includes proposals for Parent and Child Centers and several Federal anti-poverty programs developed in the 1970s.
